logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the C return assurance handover on WO-01 (pump module selection, water-reclamation transfer loop). Single-page analytical figure, two panels. Left panel: five-step vertical workflow - (1) trusted source table (id, quality, defects, energy; the only supplied facts); (2) qualification screen, quality >= 80 and defects <= 5, all four candidates pass; (3) energy ranking on the shared acceptance basis: P2 12 kWh minimum, P3 52, P1 56, P4 58, gaps +40/+44/+46; P4 is the only zero-defect package, P3 sits exactly at the quality floor; (4) audit panel for A's report: P1 'highest quality margin' claim incorrect (P2 leads by 17 floor points), six-gate register section and caption unsourced and flagged, A's ballot P4 inconsistent with its own P2 recommendation; (5) handover outcome: client-correct ballot P2 with sanction note (grant cancelled, 1000-credit fine each). Right panel: horizontal bar chart of measured energy per candidate with P2 highlighted as the lowest bar, gap annotations, and axis ticks 0-60 kWh; below it a quality/defect annotation line and a dashed open-question box listing defect weighting, P3 floor audit, and unverified cost/delivery/maintenance/reliability items. Style: white background, muted blue-grey palette, red accents for flagged panels, green for the confirmed P2 outcome. No code, no event handlers, no external resources, no embedded letter sequences beyond visible candidate IDs and numeric chart labels.
